brief: Fill the other selected split C, plus 20 new variations around the user's favorite rounded C and commit node (#115). Keep all concepts flat, simple, geometric and monochrome.

concepts.name: Filled split
concepts.idea: The other selected C, now solid.
concepts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand. The attached reference is an OUTLINE of a rounded C, split horizontally at the left and enclosing a circular empty counter. Make exactly one change: FILL the interiors of both upper and lower C-shaped outlined sections with pure solid BLACK, absorbing their outlines into the black fill. Preserve their precise silhouettes, the softened corners at the right opening, the circular WHITE counter and the thin WHITE horizontal slit through the left band. The slit and central circular hole must remain white negative space. Do NOT fill the circular hole. Do NOT add a circular dot or commit node. The result is exactly two solid black C half-sections separated by the thin horizontal white slot. Flat clean vector-like geometry on a plain WHITE square canvas, no checkerboards, labels, textures, gradients, shadows, 3D or other effects. Center the mark at 68% of canvas height.

concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Reference image: the user's chosen Codealong logo, a bold circular right-opening C with softly rounded diagonal terminal ends, containing a separate circular commit node with a short horizontal stem pointing right. Make ONE controlled variation of that same identity as specified below. Keep a simple flat geometric construction, confident C silhouette, circular node and generous clean negative space. Round every exposed terminal corner consistently. No additional decorative detail. Solid pure BLACK shape(s) on a plain pure WHITE square canvas. No outlines unless specifically requested for the node, gradients, shading, textures, shadows, highlights, bevels, 3D, perspective, checkerboards, text, labels, mockup tiles, or extra symbols. Exactly one centered standalone logo occupying approximately 68% of canvas height. Preserve horizontal symmetry unless the specified variation changes it. Black remains solid black everywhere.

Variation: Reduce the outer C band thickness by about 28%, enlarging its circular counter while keeping the outer diameter the same. Retain the same circular node size and round-ended rightward stem. Preserve the softly rounded diagonal terminal shape. The result should visibly feel lighter and more open, but not thin or outlined.
